title: Bruny Island Tasmanian language
displaytitle: Bruny Island Tasmanian language

titles.display: Bruny Island Tasmanian language

extract: Bruny Island Tasmanian, or Nuenonne ("Nyunoni"), a name shared with Southeast Tasmanian, is an Aboriginal language or pair of languages of Tasmania in the reconstruction of Claire Bowern. It was spoken on Bruny Island, off the southeastern coast of Tasmania, by the Bruny tribe.
